name: text
description: Text and heading primitives with size, color, weight, alignment, and truncation via data attributes

changes.note: data-variant="mono" text sets font-variant-ligatures: var(--mono-ligatures), a new typography token that defaults to none. --font-mono names Cascadia Code and JetBrains Mono, and both ligate by default, so on any machine with either installed an id, an operator or a path containing !=, => or -> was drawn as one joined glyph. none also turns contextual alternates off, which is how JetBrains Mono ligates. Set --mono-ligatures: normal to get a face's ligatures back. Text that is mono only because a theme points a type role at --font-mono (terminal) is not covered.

An anchor carrying data-ui="text" reads as a link. The reset takes every anchor's colour and underline away and text.css gave nothing back, so <a data-ui="text" href> could not be told from the text beside it. A [data-ui="text"]:any-link rule now draws the underline from the link tokens (--link-decoration, --link-thickness, --link-underline-offset) in currentColor, and a :focus-visible twin draws the focus ring. The text keeps its own colour, variant and size, so a table of mono id links does not turn primary; an anchor with no href and every non-anchor root are untouched, and data-state="done" still strikes a link through. New html_link template. :any-link selects on no attribute, so nothing new is declared.

Headings and data-variant="mono" text set overflow-wrap: anywhere, so a heading or mono run that is one unbreakable token (an id, a hash, a path) breaks instead of widening its flex or grid parent past the page. anywhere rather than break-word, because only anywhere lowers the min-content width a parent sizes the element by. Text with ordinary break opportunities wraps where it always did. Inside a table cell the table's own wrapping applies instead (table 3.2.1). data-truncate is unchanged.
Keep visible subtle and completed text on the AA-gated muted foreground; color-fg-subtle remains reserved for decorative, placeholder, and disabled content.

data-truncate, data-tabular and data-state="done" are now declared — all three were in text.css and in no manifest. The two authored, valueless switches are boolean props; "done" is a state because it rides the protocol's data-state attribute, which is the runtime's vocabulary. No CSS or behaviour change. 0.8-10's undeclared-attribute rule now makes this class of drift impossible: an attribute a component's CSS selects on that its manifest never declares fails the registry gate.

done.description: Completed item — strikes the text through and drops it to the AA-gated muted foreground (checklists, todo rows)

truncate.description: Clip overflowing text to a single line with an ellipsis

tabular.description: Lay the text out as an aligned column at least --text-tabular-width wide (8ch by default) with tabular figures — for label/value lists

keyboard.Enter: Follows the link (anchor root with an href only)

a11y.notes: The root may be an <a href> when the text itself is the link: an id, a ref, a version or a timestamp in a table or a list. It keeps the text's colour, variant and size and gains the theme's link underline and the focus ring. Without an href an anchor is not a link and is not styled as one. Link text must say where it goes. For a link in running prose, or one that should stand out in the primary colour, use data-ui="link" instead.

safe_transforms: Change data-size to any listed value
Change data-variant to any listed value
Change data-weight to any listed value
Change data-align to any listed value
Make the root an <a href> when the text itself is the link
tests: Heading sizes map to correct font-size
Anchor root with an href is underlined in its own colour; a done link is struck through
